title: The base point matches the path
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let a path on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ specify values at some coordinates. The point whose value at each specified coordinate is the path's assigned value, and whose value at every unspecified coordinate is $0$, agrees with every value specified by the path.
